name: com.pulsemcp/tailscale
description: MCP server for administering a Tailscale tailnet: read-only introspection plus autonomous policy-file (ACL), device, and auth-key management.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tailscale API access token (Bearer). Required unless using OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID. Required (with the secret) unless using an API key.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret. Required (with the ID) unless using an API key.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_TAILNET
environmentVariables.description: Tailnet to operate on. Use '-' for the default tailnet of the token.

environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Tailscale API (include the /api/v2 path).

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of enabled tool groups.
